pairs.evidence: app/_lib/jobseeker/rules/engine.ts:254 The engine assembles records containing missing required fields instead of rejecting those records, weakening extraction failure semantics.

pairs.evidence: app/features/jobseeker/RulesAuthoring.tsx:110 A failed re-preview leaves the previous successful preview intact and the save gate armed, allowing persistence after live verification fails.

techniques.evidence: app/features/jobseeker/ScanRunTable.tsx:35 The run table omits unchanged and total-seen reconciliation counts, preventing the complete per-harvest accounting required by the technique.
